name: Obdolbos 3
description_html:
It’s a standalone version of the Obdolbos 2 (but the old one, before the 3.7)

This mod don’t remove your Obdolbos 2, it add another new one called Obdolbos 3.

Found at Therapist 4 for 285k roubles and on flea market for aproximatly 400k

You can config :

Localization : (default “EN”) “You have to choose one of these: EN, FR, CH, CZ, ES, GE, HU, IT, JP, KR, PL, PO, RU, SK, TU”

blacklistFromInventoryAI : (default false) You can choose if it’s possible to obtain them in the AI inventory or not.

My first mod, so please be good with me

I take no support for older version of Obdolbos3 1.2.0; if you have trouble with older version, please update it.
